target: B: TRAIN-OLS condition-adjusted causal trailing-48-bin voltage mean; exploratory performance proxy, not verified irreversible aging or SOH
longer_horizons: 96h: only 2 Validation origins and 1 disjoint trajectory, NOT QUALIFIED. 168h/336h: no legal origins. No boundary changes.
history_choice: 48 steps fixed after metadata-only P0, maximizes support at both qualified horizons. 96/192-step histories audited but not outcome-searched.
input: Original 14 Raw F2 slots, same fixed Top10 mask [0,3,13,11,4,9,6,7,10,8]; only historical data. Raw voltage EWMA alpha .3 independently within each input history. Both models receive exactly the same prepared tensor.
target_formula: y(t,h) = B(t+h)-B(t); train target normalization = TRAIN y standard deviation (no mean subtraction); predicted absolute proxy = B(t)+predicted delta
target_reference: B(t) is observed causal at origin, used only for target/restoration, equally for LSTM and F2. No actual future covariates enter either predictor. Future measured conditions used only to define eventual observed B label using already-frozen TRAIN OLS.
feature_scaler: Mean/std over legal TRAIN histories only, before EWMA; zero scale replaced by one. Identical scaler for both models at a given horizon.
F2: Native RegimeAwareDualPathTFT, convex fusion; all learned architecture unchanged. Only build_input/forward_history decoder length and relative coordinate denominator changed from 24 to HORIZON. Encoder remains 48, parameter count332436. No residual/LR modifications.
LSTM: Independent single-layer LSTM input14 hidden64, last hidden -> linear HORIZON. No attention, convolution, internal dropout (single layer); head has no dropout. Capacity differences reported.

pilot.success_per_model_per_horizon: Validation query-weighted delta RMSE and MAE at least 5% below zero-delta persistence, delta R2>0, terminal-step RMSE no worse than persistence; finite gradients and actual parameter updates required.
pilot.expansion_gate: Proceed only if BOTH models meet all pilot success tests at main48h. If either fails, no six-seed comparison. This conservative gate avoids expanding an unlearned/asymmetric comparison; all pilot outcomes retained. No target or hyperparameter revision in this run.

cuda: ordinary cuDNN deterministic=True benchmark=False, matmulTF32=False cudnnTF32=True, strict deterministic algorithms=False; native interpolation backward prevents strict mode, bitwise repeats not promised
metrics: float64 RMSE/MAE/R2 on delta proxy, mV. Also absolute proxy R2 separately; all queries + unique target-time-equal MSE + terminal lead + P95/P99/max. No overlap interpreted as independent replication.
holdout: Do not read outcome rows >=3074 during pilot/selection. Only after eligible final24 weights frozen: one described exploratory evaluation with frozen labels/scalers. If pilot expansion gate fails, no holdout evaluation.
stop: No hyperparameter search, no Top11, no retry for a better score, no boundary change, no automatic new Phase or RUL model. A runtime failure is retained and blocks expansion until an engineering cause is resolved without changing mathematics.
